entities.name: Parnavaz II of Iberia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pharnavaz II, of the Artaxiad dynasty, was a king (mepe) of Iberia from 63 to 30 BC. He is known as Pharnabazus in Classical sources, and is commonly identified with the Bartom or Bratman of the medieval Georgian chronicles.
